title: Chapter 408 Helper
content:
Chapter 408 Helper

Bai Ling resurrected from the dead.

With the help of the pure Heavenly Demon bloodline, Bai Ling Zhuque's characteristics were completely stimulated, and her unique aura began to appear.

Vermilion Bird!

"Such powerful vitality is worthy of being the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon!"

On the side, the old man Broken Sword, who had been silent, was about to wake up when he saw Bai Ling, stroked his beard and exclaimed.

When Bai Xu heard the words of the old man Broken Sword, hesitated for a moment, and went up to ask, "Senior, what are the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon?"

The old man Broken Sword glanced at Bai Xu and chuckled, "You guy is also one of the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon."

"The so-called four symbols of the heavenly demon are the blue dragon, the white tiger, the vermilion bird, and the black twilight."

This was the first time Bai Xu learned that he was the Four Heavenly Demonic Symbols. More importantly, his sister was the same. His sudden identity made him feel a little excited.

And at this moment, Bai Ling woke up.

"elder brother.."

As soon as he spoke, Bai Ling began to call on his brother, which was enough to show how deep the relationship between the brother and sister was.

"Sister, brother is here, brother is there all the time."

Bai Xu hurried to Bai Ling and stretched out his warm big hand to touch his sister's white and tender cheeks.

Feeling the temperature coming from his brother's hand, Bai Ling finally confirmed that he was still alive and his brother was still there.

As Bai Ling opened his big watery eyes widened, his brother's face appeared in front of him.

"Brother, you saved me again."

Bai Ling smiled.

Bai Xu smiled awkwardly, and then said solemnly to Bai Ling: "Sister, it's not my brother who saved you this time, but this, two seniors save you."

"Um?"

Bai Ling's eyes showed a hint of surprise, and then he noticed that there were two human races around him.

Oh, there is another dragon.

She knew that her brother would not lie to her, and then she didn't care about the slight pain in her body, so she quickly stood up and thanked Lu Xue and her party, "Thank you for helping her for helping her."

Lu Xue nodded.

The old man Broken Sword smiled and said, "It's just a simple task."

Ao Qing glanced at the old man Broken Sword and snorted, "It has nothing to do with you."

Ignoring this man and dragon quarrel, Lu Xue looked at Bai Xu and asked, "I know, you have a lot of opinions about the human race."

Hearing this, Bai Xu lowered his head slightly.

He did have a lot of opinions about the human race, and even Lu Xue, who saved him, was a little alert.

Although Lu Xue saved him, he felt that Lu Xue, like those people, was just greedy for his abilities and wanted to forcibly conquer himself.

However, I have already told Lu Xue that I am willing to work hard for all my life.

Regardless of whether the other party's purpose is pure or not, the other party saves his sister and he is willing to fulfill his promise.

Seeing Bai Xu not speaking, Lu Xue knew that this little guy was still a little dissatisfied.

Seeing this, Lu Xue continued, "The right to choose is given to you. If you are willing to continue to follow me, I will not treat you badly. If you are unwilling, you can take your sister away and I will never say anything. .”

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Bai Xu suddenly looked up at Lu Xue.

Lu Xue's face was calm and there was no slightest falsehood.

Seeing that Lu Xue was serious, Bai Xu suddenly pulled Bai Ling up and then bowed to Lu Xue.

"Senior, goodbye."

After saying that, the two left.

"Silly, stupid!"

When Ao Qing saw the two brothers and sisters who were leaving, he felt a little disappointed.

Being able to follow your master is a blessing from many lifetimes. I don’t know how many people and monsters squeeze their throats and want to follow your master.

These two are good. If you don’t want to, you can still run so fast.

The old man Broken Sword beside him also shook his head and sighed.

I can only say that Bai Xu is still too young and doesn’t understand what opportunity is.

"Brother, don't you hesitate?"

Bai Xu and his brother and sister who had already run far stopped.

Bai Ling looked at Bai Xu with some confusion.

Bai Xu also frowned slightly at this moment, "Sister, I wasn't sure if they were good people just now. What if they were playing hard to get."

"Then are you sure now?"

"It's almost the same."

Bai Xu touched his nose and said, "We both ran so far, and they didn't stop him. It seems that he is sincere to us."

"so,,"

Bai Ling's face was a little unnatural.

Bai Xu glanced at his sister and sighed, "Of course I'm back. Those two seniors are definitely masters among the masters, especially the senior dragon. He has the pure bloodline of the demon, and he will definitely have a bright future with them."

But Bai Ling was a little hesitant, "Brother, come whenever you want, leave whenever you want, can they agree?"

Bai Ling’s worries are not without reason.

They have all left, how can they return it?

There is only one chance.

But Bai Xu seemed to have inexplicable confidence in this regard.

"You forgot, that old man said we are the demons, um, what are you doing?"

"The four symbols of the sky demon."

Bai Ling sighed. She had just heard this name in a daze and remembered it.

"Oh, yes, the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon."

"It sounds so awesome. We join the initiative, and they definitely have no reason to refuse."

Bai Ling suddenly changed from a firebird to a vermilion bird, and she felt that her identity was not very big. For her, it would be great as long as her brother was still around.

Immediately, Bai Xu didn't say anything more and pulled Bai Ling back.

But Bai Ling felt a little uneasy.

She felt that her brother was overconfident.

When they see that they are very powerful, they may really look down on the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon.

On the other side, Lu Xue and others watched the brother and sister leave without stopping.

"To be precise, this is already the territory of the Heavenly Demon Clan."

The old man Broken Sword looked around and said affirmatively.

In the past, at the junction of the human race and the Tiandemon tribe, a large number of powerful people from the Tiandemon tribe would definitely gather to guard it.

And they even often launch beast tides of various sizes, which make the human race frightened.

But now, as the human race grows stronger and stronger, these phenomena are gone.

At this moment, this place even seemed a bit desolate, leaving only some inconspicuous monsters in the mountains.

Lu Xue stood there, pondered for a moment, then said to Ao Qing on her shoulder: "Xiaoqing, call some helpers over."

Upon hearing this, Ao Qing was stunned and his eyes lit up.

"Okay, wait a moment."

Ao Qing smiled and then the blood in his body began to boil.

At the same time, in the distant deserted city.

Everyone felt the earth begin to tremble, and suddenly the sound of a dragon roar came from the inner city.

"That's!"

Countless people stopped their movements and looked up at the direction of the inner city.

"It's Lord Longzi's call."

"After so many years, Lord Longzi finally called us."

Under the surprised gaze of the crowd in the desert city, huge giant dragons soared into the sky, hovered over the desert city for a moment, and then flew out of the desert city one after another.

Immediately afterwards, these giant dragons easily broke through the space and disappeared into the eyes of everyone.
